mapper.select: select "VALUE" from PA_DOC_TEXT_CONFIG where CODE = #{code} order by "NUM"

select.if: SELECT T1.CCY, T1.PRIN_AMT, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.VDATE vDate, T1.MDATE mDate, T7.TERM termDays, T7.RATE*100 yield, T7.BASIS, T6.PORTFOLIO_NAME, NVL(T1.P_TRADE_ID, T1.TRADE_ID) bizCode, T12.SETTLE_AMT, t14.BUSI_ACCT_NO payAcctNo, T14.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, t13.BUSI_ACCT_NO receiveAcctNo, T13.ACCT_NAME receiveAcctName, T13.BANK_DEP bankDep, T13.LARGE_PAYNO FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_STL_PAY_ORDERS T12 ON T12.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID AND T12.IS_TOTAL_TRADE = #{NO} LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_OTH T7 ON T7.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T6 ON T6.PORTFOLIO_ID = T2.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY T11 /*交易对手*/ ON T1.COUNTER_ID = T11.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T13 /*收款方*/ ON (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) OR (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T14 /*付款方*/ ON (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) OR (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) WHERE (T1.TRADE_ID = #{bizCode} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01}) OR (T1.P_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_03})

SELECT T1.CCY, T1.PRIN_AMT, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.VDATE vDate, T1.MDATE mDate, T3.TERM termDays, T5.YIELD*100 YIELD, T5.BASIS, T6.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T1.TRADE_ID bizCode, T12.SETTLE_AMT, t14.BUSI_ACCT_NO payAcctNo, T14.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, t13.BUSI_ACCT_NO receiveAcctNo, T13.ACCT_NAME receiveAcctName, T13.BANK_DEP bankDep, T13.LARGE_PAYNO FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T4 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T4.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FIN_CASH_BUSINESS_TYPE_01} AND T4.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C02} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T5 ON T4.CASH_ID = T5.CASH_ID AND T5.EFF_DATE = T3.VDATE LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T6 ON T6.PORTFOLIO_ID = T2.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY T11 /*交易对手*/ ON T1.COUNTER_ID = T11.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T12 ON T12.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID AND T12.IS_TOTAL_TRADE = #{NO} LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T13 /*收款方*/ ON (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) OR (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T14 /*付款方*/ ON (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) OR (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) WHERE T1.TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}

SELECT T1.CCY, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.VDATE vDate, T1.MDATE mDate, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2, T7.TERM termDays, T7.RATE*100 yield, T7.BASIS, T7.M_TRADE_AMT, NVL(T1.P_TRADE_ID, T1.TRADE_ID) bizCode, T12.SETTLE_AMT, t13.BUSI_ACCT_NO receiveAcctNo, T13.ACCT_NAME receiveAcctName, T13.BANK_DEP bankDep, T14.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, T14.BUSI_ACCT_NO payAcctNo FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_OTH T7 ON T7.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_STL_PAY_ORDERS T12 ON T12.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID AND T12.IS_TOTAL_TRADE = #{NO} LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T13 /*收款方*/ ON (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) OR (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T14 /*付款方*/ ON (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) OR (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) WHERE (T1.TRADE_ID = #{bizCode} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01}) OR (T1.P_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_03})

SELECT T1.CCY, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.VDATE vDate, T1.MDATE mDate, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2, T5.BASIS, T3.M_TRADE_AMT, T3.TERM termDays, T5.YIELD*100 YIELD, T1.TRADE_ID bizCode, T12.SETTLE_AMT, t13.BUSI_ACCT_NO receiveAcctNo, T13.ACCT_NAME receiveAcctName, T13.BANK_DEP bankDep, T14.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, T14.BUSI_ACCT_NO payAcctNo FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T4 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T4.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FIN_CASH_BUSINESS_TYPE_01} AND T4.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C02} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T5 ON T4.CASH_ID = T5.CASH_ID AND T5.EFF_DATE = T3.VDATE LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T12 ON T12.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID AND T12.IS_TOTAL_TRADE = #{NO} LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T13 /*收款方*/ ON (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) OR (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T14 /*付款方*/ ON (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) OR (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) WHERE T1.TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}

SELECT T1.CCY, T1.TRADE_DATE, T12.SETTLE_DATE, T1.VDATE vDate, T1.MDATE mDate, T1.FINPROD_ID finprodMarketId, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2, T6.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID bizCode, T12.SETTLE_AMT, t13.BUSI_ACCT_NO receiveAcctNo, T13.ACCT_NAME receiveAcctName, T13.BANK_DEP bankDep, T14.CORR_NO, T14.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, T14.BUSI_ACCT_NO payAcctNo, T14.BANK_DEP payBankDept FROM
WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN WFL_STL_PAY_ORDERS T12 ON T12.TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T12 ON T12.TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T6 ON T6.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T13 /*收款方*/ ON (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) OR (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T14 /*付款方*/ ON (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) OR (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) WHERE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}

SELECT SWB.NODE_NAME CUR_NODE_ID, SWB.HI_USER ASSIGNEE_, to_char(SWB.UPDATE_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') UPDATE_TIME FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE SWB WHERE WORKFLOW_ID = #{procInstId} and NODE_ID IN (#{TRADE_OPERATOR}, #{TRADE_CHECKER}, #{BACK_OPERATOR}, #{BACK_CHECKER})
SELECT REAL_NAME FROM SYS_USER WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName}

WITH RATE_ AS ( SELECT A.YIELD, A.EFF_DATE, B.CASH_TYPE_1, B.CASH_TYPE_2 FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE A INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO B ON A.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND B.FINPROD_ID IN ( SELECT FINPROD_ID FROM
WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL
TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL
WHERE TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}) AND B.FINPROD_TYPE = #{CT01} AND B.BRANCH = #{noBranchNoValue} ) , RATE_P AS ( SELECT A.YIELD, A.EFF_DATE, B.CASH_TYPE_1, B.CASH_TYPE_2 FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE A INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO B ON A.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND B.FINPROD_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT NVL(T2.P_FINPROD_ID, T2.FINPROD_ID) FROM
WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL
TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL
T1 INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID WHERE TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}) AND B.FINPROD_TYPE = #{CT01} AND B.BRANCH = #{noBranchNoValue} ) , SUMRATE_ AS ( SELECT SUM(A.YIELD) YIELD, A.EFF_DATE FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE A INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO B ON A.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND B.FINPROD_ID IN ( SELECT FINPROD_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}) AND B.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{CT_ONE_03} AND B.CASH_TYPE_2 NOT IN (#{C03}, #{C05}, #{C06}) AND B.FINPROD_TYPE = #{CT01} AND B.BRANCH = 0 GROUP BY A.EFF_DATE ) SELECT PORTFOLIO_NAME, finprodName, REP_FINPROD_STAGE/*期次*/, TRADE_DATE/*成立日*/, SALE_DEPARTMENT, DEAL_MODE/*处理模式*/, FINPROD_MARKET_ID/*产品代码*/, prinAmt/*到账金额*/, LAST_AMT_SUB lastAmtSub/*上期滚入金额*/, CURRENT_SUB currentSub, LAY_SUB laySub/*分层金额*/, mDate/*产品到期日*/, TERM/*期限*/, ENTRUST_TYPE/*发行方式*/, NO_LAY_YIELD/*预期收益率*/, LAY_YIELD/*分层收益率*/, case when C06_YIELD is null then null else TO_CHAR(C06_YIELD * 100,'990D99')||'%' end C06_YIELD, case when C05_YIELD is null then null else TO_CHAR(C05_YIELD * 100,'990D99')||'%' end C05_YIELD, case when C03_YIELD is null then null else TO_CHAR(C03_YIELD * 100,'990D99')||'%' end C03_YIELD, case when C99_YIELD is null then null else TO_CHAR(C99_YIELD * 100,'990D99')||'%' end C99_YIELD, INVESTOR_TYPE saleDepartmentString FROM ( SELECT T8.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T3.FINPROD_ABBR finprodName, T7.REP_FINPROD_STAGE /*期次*/ , T1.TRADE_DATE /*成立日*/ , T4.SALE_DEPARTMENT, T5.DEAL_MODE /*处理模式*/ , T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID /*产品代码*/ , T1.PRIN_AMT prinAmt /*到账金额*/ , T2.LAST_AMT_SUB /*上期滚入金额*/ , T2.CURRENT_SUB /*本期认购*/ , CASE WHEN T4.IS_LAY = 'N' THEN TO_CHAR(T2.CURRENT_SUB,'999G999G999G999G999G990D99') ELSE ( SELECT listagg(TO_CHAR(TRADE_AMT,'999G999G999G999G999G990D99') , '，') within GROUP (ORDER BY BRANCH) FROM
WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL
TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL
WHERE TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}) END LAY_SUB /*分层金额*/ , T1.MDATE mDate /*产品到期日*/ , T1.MDATE - T1.VDATE TERM /*期限*/ , T3.ENTRUST_TYPE /*发行方式*/ , CASE WHEN T4.IS_LAY = #{NO} THEN listagg(TO_CHAR(T9.YIELD*100, '999,990.99')||'%', ',') within GROUP ( ORDER BY t9.EFF_DATE ) ELSE NULL END NO_LAY_YIELD /*预期收益率*/ , CASE WHEN T4.IS_LAY = #{YES} THEN listagg(TO_CHAR(T9.YIELD*100, '999,990.99')||'%', ',') within GROUP ( ORDER BY t9.EFF_DATE ) ELSE NULL END LAY_YIELD /*分层收益率*/ , T10.YIELD C06_YIELD, T11.YIELD C05_YIELD, T12.YIELD C03_YIELD, T13.YIELD C99_YIELD, T14.INVESTOR_TYPE FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T2 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T4 ON T3.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PA_FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T6 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID AND T6.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_DECLARE T7 ON T6.FINPROD_ID = T7.REP_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T8 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T8.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN RATE_ T9 /*收益率*/ ON T1.TRADE_DATE = T9.EFF_DATE AND T9.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{C02} LEFT JOIN RATE_P T10 /*销售费率*/ ON T1.TRADE_DATE = T10.EFF_DATE AND T10.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{C06} LEFT JOIN RATE_P T11 /*托管费率*/ ON T1.TRADE_DATE = T11.EFF_DATE AND T11.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{C05} LEFT JOIN RATE_P T12 /*管理费率*/ ON T1.TRADE_DATE = T12.EFF_DATE AND T12.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{C03} LEFT JOIN SUMRATE_ T13 /*其他费率合计*/ ON T1.TRADE_DATE = T13.EFF_DATE LEFT JOIN PRD_SALE_PARAM T14 /*目标客户类型*/ ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T14.FINPROD_ID WHERE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode} GROUP BY T8.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T3.FINPROD_ABBR, T7.REP_FINPROD_STAGE /*期次*/ , T1.TRADE_DATE /*成立日*/ , T4.SALE_DEPARTMENT, T5.DEAL_MODE /*处理模式*/ , T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID /*产品代码*/ , T1.PRIN_AMT /*到账金额*/ , T2.LAST_AMT_SUB /*上期滚入金额*/ , T2.CURRENT_SUB /*本期认购*/ , T1.MDATE /*产品到期日*/ , T1.VDATE /*期限*/ , T3.ENTRUST_TYPE, /*发行方式*/ T4.IS_LAY , T10.YIELD , T11.YIELD , T12.YIELD , T13.YIELD , T14.INVESTOR_TYPE)
